name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.92 to 4.84 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
